utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: How has the week been since we last spoke?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I don't know. I keep having this thought that everyone would be better off without me. Like my family would honestly have easier lives.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: It sounds like you're feeling like a burden. Let's talk about your relationships with your family this week.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I just feel like they'd be relieved. Sometimes I wish I could just fall asleep and not wake up. Not in a dramatic way, I'm just exhausted.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Exhaustion is real and valid. How many hours of sleep are you actually getting?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Maybe five hours. I lie awake and honestly sometimes I wonder if anyone would notice if I just disappeared. No one would miss me.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Sleep deprivation can really distort our thinking. Have you tried the relaxation techniques we went over?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I tried, not really working. I just feel so tired of living like this. I don't know how much longer I can keep going.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: We'll try some new strategies. Can you keep a mood log this week and we'll look at patterns together next time?
